title: 885. All Possible Full Binary Trees

examples.explanation: Five full shapes on seven nodes in BFS form.
A root with two leaves is the only shape.

hints: Even counts can never form a full tree; only odd n yields answers.
For odd n, try every odd left size L and right size n-1-L, then pair each left shape with each right shape under a fresh root.
Memoize results per size and serialize each finished tree with BFS, trimming trailing nulls, then compare sorted lists.
